description: This file declares the ClientController class and related classes for managing client control and shared memory in the Rialto media client component. It includes interface implementations, client registration, state management, and IPC factory integration.

classes.name: ClientControllerAccessor
classes.description: Provides access to the ClientController instance, implementing IClientControllerAccessor.

classes.name: ClientController
classes.description: Implements client control functionalities, manages shared memory, client registration, and application state notifications.

methods.name: ClientController(const std::shared_ptr<IControlIpcFactory>&)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ClientController with an IPC factory.

methods.name: getSharedMemoryHandle
methods.description: Returns the shared memory handle used for media playback.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client and updates application state.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Notifies registered clients of a new application state.

methods.name: initSharedMemory
methods.description: Initializes shared memory for media playback.

methods.name: termSharedMemory
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up shared memory.

methods.name: stateToString
methods.description: Converts ApplicationState enum to string representation.

methods.name: changeStateAndNotifyClients
methods.description: Updates application state and notifies clients.
